issues.where: the swirled storm in the liquid and across the pond
issues.what: discrete, unblurred spoked starburst puffs float in dull tan haze instead of long curved motion-blurred streaks in a bright golden vortex, leaving the upper tree and the bottom pond far too clear
issues.fix: sweep the particles along circular streamlines as long, curved, motion-blurred golden-white filaments with bright backlit scatter that partially veils the cottage, tree, and lower pond surface

issues.where: the liquid inside the globe
issues.what: an opaque, muddy beige-tan fog fills the entire sphere and hides the dark night background that shows clearly through the upper dome in -a
issues.fix: make the liquid optically clear so the deep dark background reads through the upper dome and shoulders, keeping warm golden haze low around the lanterns and meadow

issues.where: the right flank of the sandstone base
issues.what: the backlit cascade of sparkling golden sand grains pouring from the upper-right shoulder of the base onto the sand mound is completely missing
issues.fix: add the falling curtain of fine, sunlit individual sand grains trickling down the right side of the base onto the mound below

issues.where: the right flank of the sandstone base
issues.what: the falling sand cascade is rendered as stiff white-tan strands and rigid dashed lines sticking out of the rim instead of a spray of fine backlit sand grains
issues.fix: replace the rigid strands and dashes with an airy, backlit shower of tiny individual sparkling sand grains falling onto the mound

issues.where: the sandstone base, sea glass, and shells
issues.what: the stone is cool muddy grey-taupe with flat lighting instead of warm golden-ochre cross-bedded sandstone, and the sea glass and shells are flat, opaque matte cutouts sunken into dark pits with no water droplets
issues.fix: warm the stone to creamy golden-ochre with crisp amber strata and strong golden rim light, make the sea glass thick rounded frosted pebbles glowing with transmitted light above the surface, raise the shells in plump 3D relief, and add the tiny specular golden droplets

issues.where: the sandstone base, sea glass, and shells
issues.what: as in Set A, the base reads as dull grey-taupe stone with flat lighting and recessed, opaque pastel cutouts instead of sunlit golden-ochre sandstone with translucent raised sea glass, raised shells, and water beads
issues.fix: apply warm golden-ochre cross-bedded sandstone, strong golden sunlight on the upper-left rim and right shoulder, thick translucent frosted sea glass sitting proud of the stone, raised 3D shells, and tiny glistening droplets

issues.where: the collar where the glass meets the base
issues.what: the top of the base meets the glass on a flat, smooth tan band with no raised sunlit stone lip in front and no recessed dark shadow trough seating the sphere
issues.fix: sculpt a rounded, sunlit sandstone rim along the top edge of the base and seat the bottom curve of the glass inside a dark shadowed concave recess behind it

issues.where: the collar where the glass meets the base
issues.what: the glass terminates against the same flat tan collar band with no raised sunlit sandstone lip or recessed shadow pocket under the sphere
issues.fix: seat the glass sphere down inside a rounded, sunlit sandstone lip with a dark ambient-occlusion trough beneath the glass curve

issues.where: the dandelion seeds, fireflies, and bokeh in the liquid
issues.what: dandelion seeds look like flat, heavy-spoked white wheel stamps clumped in the upper-left at uniform sharpness, leaving the dome above the tree sparse and missing the soft depth-of-field bokeh orbs and bright firefly glow
issues.fix: spread delicate, fine-haired translucent dandelion seeds and brighter glowing fireflies across the entire dome, vary focus blur across depth, and add large soft translucent green-gold bokeh discs

issues.where: the glass rim and upper-right shoulder reflection
issues.what: a thick, hard-edged opaque white crescent band sits inside the upper-right rim under the sunburst, the outer glass edge has a cool cyan tint, and the lower-left internal flare is chalky white rather than warm gold
issues.fix: remove the opaque white upper-right reflection band so the glass stays clear to the rim, warm the cyan edge tint to neutral-gold, and restore the bright golden-amber caustic flare curving up the lower-left glass wall

issues.where: the glass rim and upper-right shoulder reflection
issues.what: the same hard-edged white reflection band inside the upper-right rim and cool cyan outer edge tint appear on the glass dome
issues.fix: clear the opaque white upper-right band, warm the outer glass rim to golden-clear, and warm the lower-left glass wall highlight

issues.where: the string lanterns, street lamp, and tree trunk
issues.what: the hanging lanterns read as flat matte orange balls with almost no incandescent core or atmospheric bloom, leaving the tree trunk nearly black and the clearing behind the lamp dim
issues.fix: give the lanterns and street lamp bright creamy-gold incandescent cores with soft warm bloom that illuminates the furrowed brown tree trunk and golden grassy clearing

issues.where: the tree crown inside the globe
issues.what: the canopy is a dark, dense emerald-black mass covered in harsh pointillist speckles with little warm sunlight filtering through the branches
issues.fix: soften and warm the foliage into painterly olive-sage leaf pads with airy branch gaps and warm golden sunlight catching the upper edges

issues.where: the cottage, climbing vines, and sunflowers
issues.what: the chimney is too tall and narrow, the roof has noisy speckled tiles and bright rafters, the door is bright orange-red under oversized bushy green and neon-pink vines, and the sunflowers are flat front-facing cartoon yellow discs
issues.fix: make the chimney shorter and wider, matte down the dark slate roof and rafters, use paler weathered wall stone and a muted brown door with delicate roses, and replace the flat sunflower discs with slender, angled, translucent backlit blooms

issues.where: the cottage, lanterns, and sunflowers seen through the storm
issues.what: through the sparse storm particles, the flat matte orange lanterns, tall narrow chimney, and flat cartoon yellow sunflower discs on the left and right break the match to -a
issues.fix: give the lanterns warm incandescent bloom, match the compact chimney and cottage tones, and replace the flat sunflower discs with slender backlit golden blooms partially veiled by the swirling storm

issues.where: the inner sand shoreline, pond border, and wooden fence
issues.what: coarse dark-speckled gravel with a black gap on the far left replaces the soft powdery sunlit sand inside the glass rim, a uniform necklace of small grey cobbles rings a stark white pond reflection, and the fence sits in dark shadow
issues.fix: line the inner glass base smoothly to the left wall with fine, warmly rim-lit cream sand, replace the uniform cobble ring with a few broader mossy stones around a warm-toned pond reflection, and add warm golden highlights along the fence rails

issues.where: the sand mound and wet reflective surface around the base
issues.what: a smooth putty-like beige sheet covers the entire bottom-right corner and wipes out the dark wet mirror surface, shell reflection, and warm golden water ripples, while stippled sand dots cut across the left surface
issues.fix: pull the sand on the right into a compact mound of coarse, sparkling backlit grains over a dark wet reflective surface showing the shell mirror image and golden ripples, and replace the stippled left sand band with dark shadowed wet stone

issues.where: the sand mound and wet reflective surface around the base
issues.what: the smooth putty sheet covering the entire bottom-right is sprinkled with uniform white dots and still hides the dark wet mirror reflection, shell reflection, and warm golden background ripples
issues.fix: shape a compact conical mound of sparkling backlit sand grains at the right foot of the base and expose the dark wet reflective surface, shell mirror image, and warm golden ripples around and behind it

issues.where: the bokeh lights and dark background behind the globe
issues.what: the background is a cold navy-black void with only a few isolated, clean circles on the upper-right and dim smudges on the left instead of -a's lush overlapping cluster of warm cream-gold bokeh and golden glow
issues.fix: restore the dense overlapping cluster of warm cream-gold bokeh circles and soft golden atmospheric falloff along the upper-right and left edges, and warm the dark background from navy toward warm charcoal-black

issues.where: the bokeh lights and dark background behind the globe
issues.what: as in Set A, a cold navy-black background with sparse isolated circles replaces the overlapping warm golden bokeh cluster and ambient glow behind the right and left edges
issues.fix: add the overlapping warm cream-gold bokeh cluster and soft golden glow on the upper-right and left edges over a warmer charcoal-black background

issues.where: the sunburst on the upper-right glass rim
issues.what: the flare sits slightly inside the rim with shorter, broader, uniform star spikes instead of fine varied diffraction needles centered right on the outer glass edge
issues.fix: center the sunburst on the outer glass rim and lengthen and thin the diffraction rays with natural variation
